div.div: الضُّرَاحُ , (O, K, TA,) or, accord. to Mujáhid, ↓ الضَّرِيحُ , (O, TA, *) [The temple called] البَيْتُ المَعْمُورُ, (O, K, TA,) corresponding to, or over against, [i. e. directly over,] the Kaabeh, (O, TA,) in Heaven, (O,) in the Fourth Heaven, (K, TA,) or in the Seventh, or in the Sixth, and said to be beneath the عَرْش, or in the First Heaven: (TA:) accord. to 'Alee, it is entered every day by seventy thousand angels. (O.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
